windows_cdd_filter.fallback: If zero input modes survive, DrvGetModes reports four orientation variants of its 800x600 32-bpp 60 Hz default. The corresponding physical monitor-validated list instead contains four entries for format 22 only.
windows_cdd_filter.comparison_source: WinX display-only sample AddSingleSourceMode advertises D3DDDIFMT_A8R8G8B8. Native KMD additionally retains POST X8R8G8B8.

public_failing_sequence: The two earliest DXGI error stacks include CDXGISwapChain::CPrepWin32Sentinel::PrepUser on both attempts. At the sampled return address the nonzero result is from user32 ChangeDisplaySettingsExW with CDS_FULLSCREEN and is converted to E_FAIL. The independent GDI test, unlike the original DXGI log, exposes DISP_CHANGE_BADMODE directly.

prior_merged_contracts.observed_scope: Earlier Windows traces recorded non-NULL MMIO flips and identity storage with rotated display mode. NULL-context and quarter-turned primary-store contracts have additional on-board WDK model controls. These data do not establish that ordinary Windows clients supplied those exceptional inputs.
